<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-DEV-007</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Devices</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Device side (connection timeout or refused)</b></div></div>

## Why it happens

A firewall blocks the port, the port is not published in Docker, or the protocol is switched off. The defaults are MQTT 1883, MQTT over TLS 8883, HTTP 8080, CoAP 5683 and CoAP over DTLS 5684 (UDP).

## Fix it

1. From the device's network, test the port: `Test-NetConnection <server> -Port 1883` on Windows or `nc -vz <server> 1883` on Linux.
2. Open the port in the server's firewall and any firewall between.
3. With Docker, publish the port in the compose file.
4. Check the protocol is on under **Settings > General > Device connectivity**.

## Check that it worked

The port test succeeds and the device connects.
